# CG-API-001: Operation removed

An operation in the baseline has no counterpart in the candidate.

**Why it matters:** Removing an operation is the most direct way to break existing consumers.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Operations and paths](./#api) |
| Detects | `operation.removed` |
| Severity | breaking: critical · potentially breaking: high · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Operation {operation} was removed.
>
> Consumers that call {operation} will receive an error (typically 404 or 405) from a provider that implements the candidate.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the operation (mark it deprecated first), or release the removal as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: method removed from a path with other methods

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}, delete: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, critical. Operation DELETE /a was removed.

### Fires: deprecated operation removed (severity downgraded)

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}, delete: {deprecated: true, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Operation DELETE /a was removed.

### Does not fire: path parameter renamed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /u/{id}: {get: {parameters: [{name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /u/{userId}: {get: {parameters: [{name: userId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: candidate adds methods

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /a: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}, post: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- The specification may differ from what the implementation still serves.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-API-001
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-API-001: { severity: low }
```
